why: The Curator's third option, the one that walks past the label, reworded from a statement (`Skip the label.`) into a question (`Must I read it?`), in English and in its Chinese rendition; its effects are untouched, so choosing it still completes `obj/hear-the-curator`, and it still has no `next`. The player asks, the dialog closes, and nobody answers - the shape a playtest found in a closing dialogue where both options were questions whose only effect was to complete an objective. Only the words change, so no other check reads anything new: the label is as wide as before, the key set is the same, and the provenance row follows the English. It declares no unit: what must not compile is a question with no line after it.
